label: Underived NECESSARY_2 concretum, from necessity, closed collections, J1 and coverage (inference)
rule: Reductio with excluded middle: the actual necessary concreta form a nonempty collection, closed under actual grounds by J1; a root among them would be underived at every admitted world by coverage
meaning: The join's endpoint from a necessary concretum, the closed-collection condition, J1, coverage and excluded middle, without AGWF, J2 or reflexive access. The witness may differ from the given necessary concretum. Conditional consequence only.
